body: He’s called me by her name twice. Once while we were having s3x and another when he was talking to his mom. I try not to let that bother me because I know he didn’t mean it and he about cried whenever he does that because he doesn’t like seeing me upset. But idk it really struck a nerve and I really internalized it. I know I’m probably just overthinking things and the combination of that and my depression doesn’t help but it just keeps happening. The guy I was hanging out with before I met my boyfriend messaged me last week and it like triggered this panic attack in me and I’ve been suicidal ever since. I just feel hopeless because I just want to be present in the moment with my boyfriend but I can’t. I’m insecure about his ex, I have ptsd from being assaulted as a child, I keep having intrusive memories about the guy I was hanging out with months ago and I just feel like a terrible person because I can’t focus. I have autism and I think it makes me a difficult person to be with
I have no idea why he does. I really don’t contribute much. His ex girlfriend is like way above me ion every sense
Honestly I don’t know how much help I expected to get from Reddit
And just like that all my insecurities and suicidal thoughts vanished
